findings.summary: The contract text is closed, but executable certificate schemas and a non-vacuous Lean model do not yet bind certificate values to the frozen contract and observed objects.

Nonce uniqueness alone does not enforce one run per contract, implementation, and phase; reviewer independence and issuer authenticity remain self-asserted, and authorization bytes are not frozen before consumption.

The watchdog is separated from monitor and inner cgroups, but its own blocking or OOM has no independently surviving deadline executor, and role-specific signal and cgroup isolation are not certified.
The specified freeze-before-supervisor-exit order can make the required zero-descendant state unreachable, and four distinct worker PIDs do not prove four-worker concurrency.

The state enumeration omits detachedMarkerInstalled and quarantine although transitions and failure handling require them; postcheck and stage-root framing are incomplete and marker-path uniqueness is undefined.

Required artifact fields can still be satisfied by empty arrays, zero counts, arbitrary digests, false booleans, and a self-asserted passed status without relational constraints over the complete tree.
Source and tool closure certificates are first-class in prose but permit empty descriptor and dependency sets and do not prove exact coverage of the eleven frozen tools or certificate kinds.
Role-specific mount, signal, cgroup, user-namespace, file-descriptor, and writable-path matrices are absent; the host-network probe descriptor is not required to be closed before exec.

required_next_version: closed schemas for conformance, authorization, attestations, nonce consumption, every certificate kind, postcheck, and detached markers with nonempty cardinality and cross-field constraints
a ledger uniqueness key over contract, implementation, and phase plus nonce, frozen authorization file descriptors before consumption, and explicit issuer, author, and reviewer identity constraints
an independently surviving outer deadline executor or a bounded nonblocking watchdog protocol whose failure is itself closed
a reachable supervisor-exit then frozen-residual-snapshot quiescence protocol with exact concurrent worker evidence
a complete success and failure state relation including detachedMarkerInstalled and quarantine, framed three-stage roots, and an injective marker naming function
nonempty complete artifact trees with count, fsync, ownership, mode, link, and root-fold relations
exact source, tool, loader, and certificate-kind closure cardinalities
a closed role-by-mount-by-permission-by-signal-by-cgroup-by-file-descriptor matrix and an eight-GiB parent hard limit
a theorem that reachability of authoritative implies all exact v0.3 gates
